# 只有变化的次序被登记：插入或移除空步不改变一步的规律、段上的总量与计数以及复现；每步所计的（速率、储备承载多久）相对于读法的单位 / Only the order of change registers: inserting or removing idle steps leaves the laws of one step, the totals and counts over a stretch, and recurrence unchanged; what is counted per step, rates and how long a reserve carries, is relative to the unit of the reading

## 主张 Claim

一个停顿（Stutter ρ）指 ρ 0 = 0，每步或空（ρ (n+1) = ρ n）或前进一步，且每步都被到达；经 ρ 读用 Sampling 的 sample。空步上没有参与：平衡、耗散与封闭在每个家族上成立，存量耗减在持有所立者的家族上成立（Flow.sample_idle_balancesOn 等）；前进步上各自恰在所读之步上成立时成立（Flow.sample_moves_balancesOn_iff 等）。所以经停顿读的世界恰在原世界满足前提时满足它们（World.stutter_premises_iff）：平衡（每步每个关系项列出一次）、耗散、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用、活动需要支持、体现与有界的传递；与较粗的读法不同，不需要关于活动如何保持的条件。任何段上的总量就是所读之段的总量（stutter_total；Flow.stutter_taken、Flow.stutter_given、stutter_risen、stutter_fallen、stutter_rise_count、stutter_fall_count，以及在已定之处的 stutter_comings、stutter_ceasings）；生起、止息与立的变化恰在原来复现时复现（World.stutter_arisingRecurs_iff、World.stutter_ceasingRecurs_iff、World.stutter_change_recurs_iff）；普查经停顿保留（World.stutter_counted），给出每个原步的读法之步时返回（World.stutter_counted_of_section）。停顿改变的是每步所计的：空步出现得任意晚时，没有流无终地更多（Flow.sample_not_more）；扩张无终地更多，每步读两次则不然（Expansion.more_step_relative）；由一份储备承载的世界在每步读两次时需要至少两份（Lapse.reserve_step_relative）。移除空步是一个构造：给出读每个原步的移动之步（Stutter.Moves；每个都存在，Stutter.crosses，且唯一，Stutter.moving_unique），且世界的空步中无参与者、无变动（World.IdleAt），去掉它们的世界（World.withoutIdle）恰在原世界满足每个前提处满足它（World.withoutIdle_premises、World.withoutIdle_transmits），不需要关于列出的条件，因为每步保留自己的交换；恰在原世界有普查处有普查（World.withoutIdle_counted）；在任一段上有相同的所取与所给总量、家族所立的升降及其计数（World.withoutIdle_totals），活动可判定时有相同的生起与止息计数（World.withoutIdle_counts）。不加前提。 / A stuttering (Stutter ρ) has ρ 0 = 0, each step idle (ρ (n+1) = ρ n) or moving by one, and every step reached; it is read with Sampling's sample. At an idle step nothing takes part: balance, dissipation and closure hold on every family, and running down on a family holding what stands (Flow.sample_idle_balancesOn and others); at a moving step each holds exactly where it holds across the step read (Flow.sample_moves_balancesOn_iff and others). So a world read through a stuttering meets the premises exactly where it meets them (World.stutter_premises_iff): balance (each relatum listed once at each step), dissipation, only active relata giving, only active relata taking, activity needing support, embodiment and bounded transmission; unlike a coarser reading, no condition on how activity is held is needed. Over any stretch the totals are those of the stretch read (stutter_total; Flow.stutter_taken, Flow.stutter_given, stutter_risen, stutter_fallen, stutter_rise_count, stutter_fall_count, and where decided stutter_comings, stutter_ceasings); arising, ceasing and change of standing recur exactly where they recurred (World.stutter_arisingRecurs_iff, World.stutter_ceasingRecurs_iff, World.stutter_change_recurs_iff); a census survives a stuttering (World.stutter_counted) and returns where a step of the reading is given for each step (World.stutter_counted_of_section). What a stuttering changes is what is counted per step: with idle steps arbitrarily late no flow is more without end (Flow.sample_not_more); the expansion is more without end and, every step read twice, it is not (Expansion.more_step_relative); a world carried by a reserve of one needs a reserve of at least two when every step is read twice (Lapse.reserve_step_relative). Removing idle steps is a construction: given for each step read the moving step reading it (Stutter.Moves; each exists, Stutter.crosses, and is unique, Stutter.moving_unique) and the idle steps of the world empty and unmoved (World.IdleAt), the world without them (World.withoutIdle) meets every premise exactly where the world does (World.withoutIdle_premises, World.withoutIdle_transmits), with no condition on listing since each step keeps its own exchange, has a census exactly where it does (World.withoutIdle_counted), and over any stretch has the same totals taken and given, rises and falls of a family's standing and their counts (World.withoutIdle_totals), and where activity is decided the same counts of arising and ceasing (World.withoutIdle_counts). No premise.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 停顿 ρ 是给定的读法；World.withoutIdle 从给定的移动步 σ 构造移除空步的世界，保持结论使用 Stutter.Moves ρ σ 与 World.IdleAt。 / The stuttering ρ is a given reading; World.withoutIdle constructs the world with idle steps removed from supplied moving steps σ, with preservation proved under Stutter.Moves ρ σ and World.IdleAt.
- 插入停顿的取用与给予总量要求每个关系项列出一次；withoutIdle 的移除总量不需要这一条件。生起与止息的计数要求活动已定。 / The taken and given totals for inserting a stuttering require each relatum listed once; the withoutIdle removal totals require no such condition. Counts of arising and ceasing require activity decided.
- 移除空步把每个原步的移动之步作为给定函数 σ（Stutter.Moves）；每个移动步都存在且唯一，但本模块没有从停顿单独构造这个函数。 / Removing idle steps takes the moving step reading each step as a supplied function σ (Stutter.Moves); each moving step exists and is unique, but this module does not construct that function from the stuttering alone.

P78（工作板），按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“move towards 100%”：零前提计划把共享的离散步序号列为表示的承诺，像 P69 对出发点那样重新奠基。这里给出 Sampling 的严格递增读法的逆：插入空步。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：对一步的规律、段上的总量与计数以及复现，步序号不携带变化次序以外的东西；空步什么也不登记；每步所计的相对于读法的单位，正如较粗的步。见整合文档 §102。 / P78 (work board), following Ren's “move towards 100%” of 12 October 2026: the zero-premise plan lists a shared discrete index of steps among the commitments of the representation, to be re-founded as P69 re-founded the starting point. This gives the converse of Sampling's strictly increasing reading: inserting idle steps. Reading (the AI's, pending Ren): for the laws of one step, the totals and counts over a stretch, and recurrence, the step index carries nothing beyond the order of change; an idle step registers nothing; what is counted per step is relative to the unit of the reading, as with coarser steps. See the integration document §102.
